initialize_model_from_weights: initialize a Detectron model from a pickled weights file with optional multi-GPU broadcast
initialize_gpu_from_weights: initialize a Caffe2 network on a specific GPU from a weights file with momentum support
save_model_weights: save model parameters and momentum blobs to a pickled weights file with config metadata
broadcast_parameters: copy parameter blobs from GPU 0 to all other GPUs in a multi-GPU setup
print_network: print the Detectron model network with input and output blob shapes for each operator
